scope: Item 5 current debt aging and due-date report

source_policy.payable: SupplierInvoice unpaid/partial, non-deleted, positive remaining_amount. WHT is not deducted a second time.
source_policy.receivable: CreditSale invoiced/partial, total minus paid, linked customer invoice. Excludes draft/approved/cancelled/paid, POS sales, branch wallets and SaaS billing.
source_policy.scope: Selected company and branch only; no station scope or company-wide expansion. Requires accounting.report.view and the selected source view permission.
source_policy.time: Current balances; aging computed by Bangkok calendar date, not historical as-of balances.
source_policy.consistency: Summary, paginated details and top counterparties read in one PostgreSQL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY transaction.
source_policy.due_windows: Overdue, today, today through today+7, today through today+30. Future windows exclude overdue. All summary totals follow selected filters.
source_policy.warnings: Flags inconsistent AP balances or missing AR invoice evidence without repairing or hiding the outstanding amount.

verification.postgres_clone: One boundary matrix for both AP/AR: day -91/-90/-61/-60/-31/-30/-1/0/1/7/8/30/31, partial balances, paid/cancelled/draft/deleted/other branch exclusions, search, pagination, partner sums and read-only refresh.
verification.repeat_policy: Successful backend unit/integration checks ran once. Browser checks rerun after correcting missing username in shared test fixture; no financial retesting.
verification.live_smoke: Both scoped reports and bucket reconciliation read successfully, no live test writes.
verification.visual: Tablet screenshot inspected; no page-level horizontal overflow, detail table scrolls within its container. Offline/error/mismatch/stale data are hidden.

rollback.schema: Unchanged creditsale0031; no migration or database restore required for image rollback.
rollback.verification: Backup restored in isolated PostgreSQL; previous images retained and script syntax checked. Healthy live UAT was not unnecessarily rolled back.

limits: Current selected-branch report only; no historical as-of reconstruction or multi-branch rollup.
Top counterparties limited to 20 grouped rows; invoice details paginated. AR historical name changes can produce separate counterparty rows.
No automatic collection/payment, reminder notifications, cash-flow forecast or bank reconciliation.
No export file or physical-print acceptance added in this release.
Accountant acceptance pending; Item 6 cost/break-even reporting remains separate work.
